en: After the ruling, the two chose first not to damage each other further, rather than call each other friends again. Da-eun corrected the unverified post, and Su-min recorded the old harm privately. The father issue moved to a separate verification process, and Da-eun would face the fiancé's conduct directly. zh-CN: 宣判后，两人没有急着重新称彼此为朋友，而是先选择不再进一步伤害对方。多恩更正未经确认的帖子，秀敏把过去受害留下非公开记录。父亲的问题转入单独确认程序，未婚夫的行为也由多恩亲自面对。结尾不是公开揭露，而是有限整理。
